name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Blueberry Banger
description: Blueberry Banger lives up to its name, delivering bold bursts of ripe blueberry flavor with every pull. Sweet, fruity, and irresistibly smooth, this sativa is all about keeping your energy high and your mood lifted. With a flavor that lingers and a buzz that inspires, this 2g disposable is perfect for those who like their fruit fresh and their vibes upbeat.
